scope: One exploratory combined candidate using existing matched gate_fit/tuning; no new experts, no images, no final-test access.
independence: Specified before candidate development scoring; no other new ablation development outcomes consulted.

method.architecture: Original 8->32 ReLU->1 sigmoid, output head initialized to zero
method.features: Original 8 gate inputs standardized on gate_fit only; score variant masks standardized quality columns 5:8 to zero
method.loss: Equal mean over clean/jpeg70/resize05 of all within-condition fake-real pair softplus(-(zf-zr)/T)
method.temperature: max(1, std(ddof=0) of gate_fit 0.5*(zg+zl), all three conditions), one fixed value per data seed
method.optimizer: AdamW lr=.003 weight_decay=1e-4, full batch, float32 CPU, 2 threads
method.selection: Mean per-condition tuning AUROC over clean/jpeg70/resize05, epoch0 included, improvement >1e-6, retain earliest within tolerance
method.threshold: Pooled tuning Youden J; original np.isclose ties closest probability threshold .5
method.baselines: Average alpha .5 and original tuning-selected fixed alpha, inherited experts
method.reporting: All selection SD15 and development ADM/BigGAN x clean/jpeg70/jpeg50/resize05, initializations averaged within data seed
method.claims: Combined bounded residual plus ranking objective candidate; no single-component causal attribution; no hyperparameter search or performance-driven retries
